mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE increases by >0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and real consumption (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime (INDPRO below 12-month average), a monthly industrial production increase above 0.5% signals improving supply conditions, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO rises >0.5% and INDPRO is below its 12-month average.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth above 2% (annualized) signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate earnings outlook.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when quarterly GDP growth (annualized) exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% year-over-year signals accelerating price pressures, prompting aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) and unemployment decline (UNRATE) above their 3-month moving averages indicate labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds its 3-month moving average and UNRATE falls below its 3-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime (INDPRO declining and below 12-month average), a monthly industrial production increase above 0.3% signals recovery, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO rises >0.3% and INDPRO is declining below its 12-month average.
